audit: Chen et al. 2010/2011 chroman ROCK-II source audit

primary_source.title: Asymmetric synthesis of potent chroman-based Rho kinase (ROCK-II) inhibitors

access_status.article: not archived; RSC article PDF endpoint returned HTTP 403
access_status.official_si: not archived; supplied RSC SI URL returned HTTP 404 in this retrieval
access_status.accessible_primary_content: RSC indexed landing-page metadata/abstract only; no full source table or experimental section obtained

source_supported_findings: The RSC abstract describes asymmetric synthesis of chroman-based ROCK-II inhibitors and says inhibitory properties against ROCK-II and selected homologous kinases were studied.
The public RSC landing-page metadata dates first publication to 2010-12-06 and the issue citation to MedChemComm 2011, volume 2, pages 73-75.
ChEMBL assay CHEMBL3226111 is annotated 'Inhibition of ROCK2 (unknown origin) after 4 hrs by HTRF assay', target CHEMBL2973, human target organism, confidence score 9, and document CHEMBL3217726.
The archived ChEMBL activity snapshot contains 10 records for this assay, all standard type IC50 and nM units; database relations must be preserved, including censored values.

The IUPHAR/BPS page links compound 11d (CHEMBL3221815) to this publication and displays a ROCK2 HTRF record with a <1 nM IC50, but this is a secondary database presentation, not a replacement for the primary table.

method_fields.species: ChEMBL target organism is Homo sapiens, but the assay description says unknown origin; species of the experimental protein is not independently confirmed in the primary article.
method_fields.construct: unresolved from the primary article/SI; a related 2008 HTRF/ROCK-II assay publication describes human ROCK-II 1-543, but that cannot be assumed to be the exact construct used in this 2011 study.
method_fields.ATP: unresolved from the primary article/SI; supplier protocol pages are secondary and were not used as primary evidence.
method_fields.readout: HTRF supported by ChEMBL/IUPHAR annotations; exact primary assay protocol unavailable.
method_fields.controls: no exact primary weak/inactive control table verified.

count_and_eligibility.reason: Only 10 ChEMBL records are linked to the mapped assay, and the primary source table/SI could not be accessed to verify complete compound count, structures, construct, ATP, or exact values.

recommendation: Do not use as a >=20-compound independent benchmark. It can remain a one-series sensitivity source only after primary access or an authoritative protocol resolves construct/readout details and compound identities; retain censored relations and do not infer exact values from supplier summaries.
